svg.title: Payments, sessions and the risk register
svg.desc: Three products on one line. IBM Safer Payments: build, test and deploy fraud models on production data without interrupting real-time processing. IBM Trusteer: device, network, behavioral biometrics, account data and global intelligence, read in each session. IBM OpenPages: risk, compliance and audit on one GRC platform, with only the modules you need.
